newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: NWE oil products dip $1, except fuel oil.
newsitem.headline: NWE oil products dip $1, except fuel oil.

text.p: NWE oil products dipped by about $1 on Thursday, except fuel oil which, after a dormant Wednesday, was slightly up, dealers said.

Gasoline fell by $1 in line with futures' losses. Eurograde barges traded at $196 fob AR and $196.50 fob ARA early in the session. Rotterdam product was offered at $198 fob. May swaps were $1 down, also at $198.
Heating oil barges fell around $1 a tonne as IPE May gas oil dropped. Offered premiums were stable at May +$1 fob Rotterdam.
High sulphur fuel oil barges traded once at $81.50 fob for delivery by May 5.
Later offers were at $82, or $82.50/$83 for delivery by May 10, a gain of about $1 from Tuesday. Traders said Wednesday was a lost day with a public holiday in the Netherlands.
Despite the return of Dutch players, the bunker market remained very quiet.
